townGuide.headline: A recorded locality rather than a tourist destination
townGuide.intro: The churchyard and surviving old buildings provide real historic interest, but one quiet heritage site does not make the locality a 60+ town.
perfectFor: Identifying the locality while planning a wider route

features.name: St Mary's Church And Churchyard, Old Kinnernie
features.documentedDateText: Medieval church and churchyard; church documented in a grant of 1204–1211
features.fullDescription: Rubble walled parallelogram enclosure containing ruins of rectangular church approx 20' x 67', little more than foundations. 2 mortsafes with slab tops. A few old gravestones.

features.name: Old Kinnernie
features.fullDescription: 18th century. L-plan block, pinned rubble with cherry cocking. 2-storey 3-window S. part with straight skews and coped chimney. N. part single storey and attic.
